text: Those who are in sorrow are wont to flee from those who are dearest to them, and to seek liberty for the indulgence of their grief: do you let her share your every thought: if you wish to nurse your grief, she will be your companion, if you wish to lay it aside she will bring it to an end.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
locator: Of Consolation, to his Mother Helvia, Chapter 19
